say.en: The molecule of heredity. You look like your parents because of a molecule two metres long, folded into every cell nucleus. DNA stores the message; RNA reads it out to build proteins. In this lesson: Name the components of nucleosides and nucleotides.
Compare DNA and RNA.

body.en: *Nucleic acids* are polynucleotides. A nucleoside is a base joined to C-1′ of a pentose sugar; a nucleotide is a nucleoside with a phosphate at C-5′. Sugar: β-D-2-deoxyribose in DNA, β-D-ribose in RNA. Bases: purines adenine (A) and guanine (G); pyrimidines cytosine (C), thymine (T, DNA only) and uracil (U, RNA only). Nucleotides join through phosphodiester links between C-5′ and C-3′ of the sugars.
body.kn: ನ್ಯೂಕ್ಲಿಯೋಟೈಡ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಮೂರು ಭಾಗಗಳು: ಸಕ್ಕರೆ, ನೈಟ್ರೋಜನ್ ಪ್ರತ್ಯಾಮ್ಲ ಮತ್ತು ಫಾಸ್ಫೇಟ್. DNA ಯಲ್ಲಿ ಡಿಆಕ್ಸಿರೈಬೋಸ್ ಮತ್ತು ಥೈಮಿನ್; RNA ಯಲ್ಲಿ ರೈಬೋಸ್ ಮತ್ತು ಯುರಾಸಿಲ್. ಫಾಸ್ಫೋಡೈಎಸ್ಟರ್ ಬಂಧಗಳು ನ್ಯೂಕ್ಲಿಯೋಟೈಡ್‌ಗಳನ್ನು ಸರಪಳಿಯಾಗಿ ಜೋಡಿಸುತ್ತವೆ.

narration.en: A nucleotide has three parts: a sugar, a nitrogen base and a phosphate. DNA uses deoxyribose and thymine; RNA uses ribose and uracil. Phosphodiester links join the nucleotides into a chain.

say.en: In the double helix, A always pairs with T by two hydrogen bonds, and G with C by three. The two strands run in opposite directions.
So in any DNA, the amount of A equals T and G equals C: Chargaff’s rule.

body.en: Watson and Crick showed that DNA is a double helix: two antiparallel strands held by hydrogen bonds between complementary bases, A with T (two hydrogen bonds) and G with C (three). So in DNA, A = T and G = C. RNA is usually a single strand; it occurs as messenger RNA (mRNA), ribosomal RNA (rRNA) and transfer RNA (tRNA). DNA carries heredity and copies itself (replication); RNA directs protein synthesis, though the message is in DNA.
body.kn: DNA ದ್ವಿಸುರುಳಿ: A ಯು T ಯೊಂದಿಗೆ, G ಯು C ಯೊಂದಿಗೆ ಜೋಡಿಯಾಗುತ್ತವೆ. RNA ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯವಾಗಿ ಏಕ ಸರಪಳಿ; mRNA, rRNA, tRNA ಎಂಬ ಮೂರು ವಿಧ. DNA ಆನುವಂಶಿಕ ಸಂದೇಶ ಸಂಗ್ರಹಿಸುತ್ತದೆ, RNA ಅದನ್ನು ಬಳಸಿ ಪ್ರೋಟೀನ್ ತಯಾರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

caption.en: Two sugar–phosphate backbones twist into a double helix. The bases point inwards, A always opposite T and G always opposite C, like rungs of a twisted ladder. Try this: Switch to the atoms view and find a sugar, a phosphate and a base: together they make one nucleotide.
caption.kn: ಎರಡು ಸಕ್ಕರೆ–ಫಾಸ್ಫೇಟ್ ಬೆನ್ನೆಲುಬುಗಳು ದ್ವಿಕುಂಡಲಿಯಾಗಿ ಸುರುಳಿಯಾಗುತ್ತವೆ. ಕ್ಷಾರಗಳು ಒಳಮುಖವಾಗಿವೆ, A ಯಾವಾಗಲೂ T ಎದುರು ಮತ್ತು G ಯಾವಾಗಲೂ C ಎದುರು, ತಿರುಚಿದ ಏಣಿಯ ಮೆಟ್ಟಿಲುಗಳಂತೆ. ಇದನ್ನು ಪ್ರಯತ್ನಿಸಿ: ಪರಮಾಣು ನೋಟಕ್ಕೆ ಬದಲಿಸಿ ಒಂದು ಸಕ್ಕರೆ, ಒಂದು ಫಾಸ್ಫೇಟ್ ಮತ್ತು ಒಂದು ಕ್ಷಾರ ಹುಡುಕಿ: ಮೂರೂ ಸೇರಿ ಒಂದು ನ್ಯೂಕ್ಲಿಯೋಟೈಡ್.

problem.en: A double-stranded DNA sample contains 20% guanine. Find the percentages of the other three bases.

steps.en: G pairs with C, so C = 20%.

narration.en: Let us solve this together. A double-stranded DNA sample contains 20% guanine. Find the percentages of the other three bases.

say.en: Let us solve this together. A double-stranded DNA sample contains 20 percent guanine. Find the percentages of the other three bases.
G pairs with C, so C equals 20 percent.
G plus C equals 40 percent, so A plus T equals 60 percent.
A equals T equals 30 percent.
So the answer is C equals 20 percent, A equals 30 percent, T equals 30 percent.

problem.en: Write the complementary strand of 5′-ATGCGC-3′ and count the hydrogen bonds between the two strands.

narration.en: Let us solve this together. Write the complementary strand of 5′-ATGCGC-3′ and count the hydrogen bonds between the two strands.

say.en: Let us solve this together. Write the complementary strand of 5′-ATGCGC-3′ and count the hydrogen bonds between the two strands.
Complement antiparallel: 3′-TACGCG-5′.
Pairs: A-T, T-A 2 plus 2 equals 4, G-C, C-G, G-C, C-G 4 times 3 equals 12.
Total equals 4 plus 12 equals 16.
So the answer is 3′-TACGCG-5′; 16 hydrogen bonds.

body.en: The two-ring purines are A and G; the one-ring pyrimidines are C, T and U. A purine always pairs with a pyrimidine, so the helix has a constant width.
